chunks: Yūnus, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “Indeed, ʿAlī عليه السلام found a woman with a man under one covering, so he lashed each one of them one hundred lashes minus one lash.”

key_terms.امْرَأَةً: a woman involved in the reported incident
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man involved in the reported incident
key_terms.غَيْرَ سَوْطٍ: minus one lash; one less than the full hundred
key_terms.فَجَلَدَ: then he flogged; administered lashes as punishment
key_terms.وَجَدَ: found or discovered in a judicial context

ai.seo_question: What was the ruling of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام for a man and a woman found together under one covering?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a judicial ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning a man and a woman found together under one covering. It indicates a discretionary hadd-related punishment applied in a case of illicitly compromising intimacy short of the fully established punishment for zina.
